what: A starship FM synth: four banks of four oscillators morphed on an X/Y nav field, a morphing resonator, multiband destruction, a delay, a tape looper and a plate reverb. 29 patches, MONO, DUO or POLY, a two-track step sequencer with chords, ORBIT and a Turing machine, and an arpeggiator.
author: joakimskurk
